eligibility.rule: all G-D1 through G-D9 hard gates must pass and no unmitigated security blocker may exist

scoring_method.gate_backed_criteria: award the full frozen criterion weight only where the exact-head evidence proves the corresponding hard-gate/capability contract for the candidate; all three candidates satisfied these contracts in the evidence run

footprint_startup_ipc.method: lower-is-better ratio normalization using score_component = component_weight * best_observed_value / candidate_value
footprint_startup_ipc.notes: Candidate-internal round-trip values are excluded because the common harness marks them reference-only. Common atlas-core handshake/status IPC is identical across candidates and therefore does not differentiate the host score.

scoring_method.accessibility_and_user_experience: 0 for all candidates because Phase 5.6.2 collected no comparative accessibility/UX evidence; zero means unscored, not failed. This preserves the frozen weight without inventing evidence and does not affect ordering.
scoring_method.rounding: display totals rounded to two decimals; selection uses unrounded component values

selection.reason: highest weighted score among candidates that passed every hard gate, driven by materially lower measured warm startup, working-set footprint and process count while preserving the same verified Shared Core and security boundaries

residual_evidence_boundaries: final installer production/signing and clean-machine smoke are Phase 5.6.4 acceptance work
accessibility and UX require real First Preview validation in Phase 5.6.3
cold-start evidence is first post-build/staged launch and does not force an OS page-cache purge
